    The covering functor and irreducible morphisms #

    Nonzero morphisms of P lift to the universal cover at any object over their source (Cover.liftAt), and lifts compose. Hence a morphism of the cover is irreducible exactly when its image in P is (Cover.isIrreducible_iff): factorizations in P lift. So the projection maps the quiver of the cover to the quiver of P.
